name: full-corpus-reproduction
title: Full BioModels reproduction across all simulators (1008 models × 5 engines)
claim: Running the full BioModels corpus through the batch-compare-biomodels composite under up to five independent ODE engines reproduces 1008 models (14.7M timecourse rows); 306 models are covered by all five engines and 725 by four or more. The complete per-model, per-engine result is committed and browsable model-by-model in the corpus explorer.
question: Across the entire BioModels corpus, do independent simulators (COPASI, Tellurium, simbio, AMICI, PySCeS) reproduce the same trajectories, and where do they diverge?
hypothesis: Standards-based SBML/SED-ML models integrate to the same solution regardless of engine; systematic disagreement flags a model-encoding ambiguity or an engine-specific numerical behaviour.
objective: Fetch and parse every BioModel, run each through every available simulator via the batch-compare-biomodels composite (fanned out over the corpus with the Ray runner), and record the full per-model, per-engine, per-variable timecourse as a single tidy dataset for cross-engine comparison.
description: This is the full-corpus reproduction run. The batch-compare-biomodels composite fetches each model's SBML, parses every SED-ML simulation, runs each engine over all jobs, and reports all-pairs nRMSE per (model, SED-ML doc). Executed over the whole corpus with viva_biomodels.ray_runner (one Ray task per model, crash-isolated). The result — 1008 models, up to five engines each, 14.7M rows — is committed at datasets/corpus_all_engines/ (a sorted tidy parquet + a compact per-model index.json) and served to the corpus explorer (Analyses tab) as one JSON per model for lazy, model-by-model browsing.

baseline.name: baseline
baseline.description: Per-model multi-engine comparison. The full run fans this composite over every BioModel id (biomodels.get_all_identifiers()) via the Ray runner; the committed dataset is the union of all per-model results.

expected_behavior.name: corpus-coverage-full
expected_behavior.rationale: The reproduction must span the corpus, not a token subset. 1008 models were fetched, parsed, and simulated.

expected_behavior.name: multi-engine-cross-check
expected_behavior.rationale: A genuine cross-engine reproduction needs most models covered by several independent engines. 725 models have >=4 engines and 306 have all five.

canonical_runs.name: full-corpus
canonical_runs.description: The full corpus sweep over all BioModels across all five engines, executed via viva_biomodels.ray_runner. Result committed at datasets/corpus_all_engines/ (tidy parquet + per-model index).
